# TripSarthi
> TripSarthi is travel agency software for India: CRM, WhatsApp shared inbox and automation, itinerary quotes, instalment payments, GST invoicing and TCS tracking, group departures, supplier rate cards and Meta/Google ad management. A product of Gamavis Software Solutions, Faridabad, Haryana.

## Key pages
- [Features](https://tripsarthi.com/features.html): Everything the product does
- [Pricing](https://tripsarthi.com/pricing.html): Starter ₹1,499, Growth ₹3,999, Pro ₹6,999 per month
- [Travel agency software](https://tripsarthi.com/travel-agency-software.html): Overview for Indian travel agencies
- [WhatsApp CRM for travel agents](https://tripsarthi.com/whatsapp-crm-for-travel-agents.html): Shared inbox and automations within WhatsApp rules
- [GST billing for travel agents](https://tripsarthi.com/gst-billing-for-travel-agents.html): GST invoices, TCS, GSTR exports
- [Tour operator software](https://tripsarthi.com/tour-operator-software.html): Group departures, supplier rates, payables
- [Blog](https://tripsarthi.com/blog/index.html): Guides for travel agents
